scientific_integrity: Exact two-atom weak-solution theorem with analytical global scalar phase portrait; finite symbolic and ODE tests reproduce calculations but do not certify unlimited parameter ranges or novelty.
scientific_limitations: Zero diffusion and exactly two initial atomic masses only; no claim for positive diffusion, finite opinion domains, continuous densities, or multicluster distributions.
The inaccessible 2023 source-cited master thesis and potentially general aggregation theory remain publication-priority risks.
title: A sharp two-cluster escape and locking phase diagram for biased Gaussian opinions
